title: cyclosorus berroi
intro: Cyclosorus berroi, commonly known as the Berroi fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus berroi include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant, which can help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
